project.name: Inspecto — Operational objects (Standard edition, optional)
project.description:
OPTIONAL Standard-edition operational objects (EDITIONS.md CP-11): Alerts -> Incidents -> Cases -> Tasks, their notes, links, tags, queues, RCA templates, findings and workflow — the com.gamma.ops domain, its four DuckDB-backed stores, the /objects, /notes, /queues and /tags route families, the object-analytics and case-rule Job Types, and the incident_purge maintenance task.
WHY THIS IS THE LARGEST EDG-01 CELL. Unlike the other six, this feature was never a leaf: 31 domain files with 23 code dependants across the mandatory inspecto-engine and inspecto modules, several of which CONSTRUCTED it (ServiceStores opened the stores, ServiceBootstrap loaded six config types, CollectorService built the ObjectService and wired its event bridge). So core reaches it through the com.gamma.objects.ObjectAccess seam and an ObjectEngineProvider, never by naming a type here.
WHAT PERSONAL LOSES, DELIBERATELY (operator decision 2026-09-08). Two EDITIONS rows were amended in the same change rather than left to contradict the build: * OPS-01 no longer lists `objects` among the operational stores Personal carries. * SP-CTL-02's gap watchdog still raises the EVENT on Personal but no longer promotes it to an ALERT object — the promotion is EventObjectBridge, which lives here. Event RECORDING is untouched in every edition; only the promotion and the managed objects are gated.
NOT IN THIS MODULE: /alerts and /alerts/rules. That is AlertsService over config-authored alert RULES — a different domain from an OperationalObject whose objectType is ALERT. AlertService stays in core and reaches this module through the seam.
Built only under the "edition-standard"/"edition-enterprise" profiles, so a routine "mvn -o clean test" (= Personal, the DEFAULT build) never compiles it.
